explanation: The island lies more than 3,000 km off the Chilean coast, and its Polynesian people call it Rapa Nui.

claims.text: Easter Island is not part of Peru, New Zealand or France.
Easter Island lies more than 3,000 km from the coast of mainland Chile.
Easter Island's Polynesian people call the island Rapa Nui.

writerNotes: Self-check (§9.3). Lint: content:check reports no errors and one C22 warning: the same answer as p.geo.0107, which asks where the Atacama Desert lies, a different fact; related, not a duplicate, for the editor to confirm with related_ok. Claims: every checkable statement is listed, distractors included; c3 (number) is high under the C26 floor, and c1, c2 and c4 are standard. Datasets: geonames-cities: Hanga Roa, CL, -27.15253, -109.42438, the island's town (c1). Caldera, CL, -27.06812, -70.81921, on the nearest stretch of the Chilean mainland, is about 3,800 km away by great circle from those coordinates (c3). Rival test: France pulls because of French Polynesia to the west, New Zealand because the island is Polynesian, and Peru because it is the next mainland country north. Against the key: nothing; the island has belonged to Chile since the 19th century. Volatility: evergreen, settled geography with no review date; no time words, and nothing depends on knowledge newer than mid-2026. Regional: Easter Island is famous worldwide for its statues, which the item does not mention. Style: Oxford spelling, plain hyphens only, straight apostrophes, explanation of 19 words. Myths: every claim screened against content/reference/myths.json; no entry matches. Mystery and encore: nothing of either kind to check in a practice item. External evidence: none beyond the dataset; c4 is standard. Seed: 3 (medium): many players know it, others guess a Pacific power. Counterintuitive: false. Doubts: none. Related: p.hist.0127 asks for the name of the island's statues, a different fact, and p.geo.0107 also has Chile as its answer.

claimResults.note: Hanga Roa, Easter Island's town, is listed under Chile (admin1 CL.01, Valparaíso).

evidence.restatement: Easter Island has been part of Chile since 1888; Peru, New Zealand and France do not hold it.

claimResults.note: Great-circle distance from the island to Punta Lavapié on the mainland coast: 3,525 km. Cross-check: the nearest of 304 mainland Chilean places in geonames-cities (Lebu) is 3,530 km from Hanga Roa. Well over 3,000 km.

evidence.restatement: The islanders, a Polynesian people, call their island Rapa Nui.
Easter Island (Rapa Nui) belongs to Chile, which annexed it in 1888.
Easter Island is not part of Peru, New Zealand or France.
